description: This file defines the QhullSet class template and its base class, providing a read-only wrapper for Qhull's setT collection, including iterators and conversion methods, within the orgQhull namespace.

classes.name: QhullSetBase
classes.description: Wrapper for Qhull's setT of void* pointers, providing basic set operations and access.

classes.name: QhullSet<T>
classes.description: Template class providing a read-only, STL-like wrapper for Qhull's setT collection, with iterator support and conversion functions.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts QhullSet to a std::vector of T.

methods.name: toQList
methods.description: Converts QhullSet to a QList of T.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a T element is in the set.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts occurrences of a T element in the set.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.description: Finds the last index of a T element.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the T element at a given index, with optional default.
